course.title: Product Design -I

content.value: A device has a first cost \$25,000 with a \$5,000 salvage value after 5 years. Calculate and plot depreciation charge and book valuc at the end of various years using straight line and double decline balancing method. Also show the differences between them.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
